svg.text: Centralized Student Portal and Automated Clearance System. Yellow box = external entity, blue rounded box = process, open-ended box = data store (tables listed under its name).
Arrow = data flow. Numbers only identify flows, not their order. Dashed = automatic (database triggers). Each section shows one area; the same entity or store can appear in several sections.
D. Payments and finance clearance (REQ-CSH-01 to REQ-CSH-03)
E. Clearance (REQ-STU-03, REQ-STU-06, REQ-DPT-01 to 03, REQ-REG-03)
F. Document requests (REQ-STU-04, REQ-REG-02, REQ-DOC-01, REQ-DOC-02)
G. Administration and audit trail (REQ-ADM-01 to 03)

Data stores are only reached through processes. Student payments are not an input: the Cashier logs payments (no payment gateway, per the charter). D10 audit_logs receives every change through process 10.0.
